clocks.source: the browser's Date/timers inside the page under observation
clocks.mechanism: playwright page.clock (install / setFixedTime / fastForward); playwright 1.57.0 is installed in this environment and Page.clock is present. It moves ONLY the browser's clock: it never reaches the hub's producers.

clocks.source: datetime.datetime.now() inside the hub process; for the brief producer it is MondayBriefService's one clock (holdspeak/services/monday_brief_service.py:142, read by generate at :197)
clocks.mechanism: producer-clock (PHILO-3-03): the brief producer takes ONE injectable clock, MondayBriefService(clock=), default the wall clock, wired from the app factory MeetingWebServer(brief_clock=) -> WebContext.brief_clock -> the brief router (holdspeak/web/routes/monday_brief.py:100). The rig's OWN hub passes the wall clock plus an offset from a file in the run's HOME; the clock step (adapter producer-clock, advance_days) writes the offset. It moves ONLY the brief producer's day in the rig's hub; the machine clock, other producers (heartbeat, cadence, SQL datetime('now')) and the MCP sidecar are not moved.

clocks.source: datetime('now') inside SQL written by the hub (holdspeak/db/projections.py:163, :169, :172)
clocks.mechanism: none within scope - it reads the same hub-process wall clock as clock.python_wall.

clocks.source: the heartbeat conductor loop (holdspeak/runtime/heartbeat.py:86 TICK_SECONDS, :111 the due test)
clocks.mechanism: PUT /api/settings/heartbeat {"sweep_every_minutes": 1} lowers the interval to its floor (holdspeak/services/heartbeat_service.py:176-178), then the run waits at most two 60s ticks. No clock is moved and the sweep is produced by the real timer. The out-of-band POST /api/settings/heartbeat/run-now reaches the same producer but is a DIFFERENT edge (owner_hand=True, holdspeak/web/routes/system/settings.py:337).

clocks.source: the meeting-intelligence queue drainer that claims and runs queued jobs (holdspeak/db/intel.py:1215-1243 selects the claimable queued rows)
clocks.mechanism: scheduler-wait: poll the real queue through GET /api/intel/jobs until the job leaves 'queued', bounded by the case's completion_bound_s. No clock is moved and no job is claimed by hand.
